newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Bucaram drops out of another presidency.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Bucaram drops out of another presidency.

text.p: Ecuador's Abdala Bucaram, booted out of the presidential palace last week, has quit another presidency -- that of leading soccer team Barcelona.

Bucaram, a former athlete and keen soccer fan, became president of the Guayaquil team last month. Reports that he had agreed to pay Argentine soccer star Diego Maradona $1 million to play a single match with the team caused an uproar.
"I don't have much time for Barcelona right now because I'm worried about the (country's) political situation," he told Reuters in a brief interview on Monday night.

He said his decision was also motivated by the "treacherous" conduct of former team president Isidro Romero, who was among the 44 legislators who voted to dismiss Bucaram on the grounds of "mental incompetence."
